title: Finetuning with Sampling: SFT Learns Better Than You Think
abstract: arXiv:2610.02140v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Introducing new capabilities to frontier models has long been the goal of posttraining, which predominantly employs supervised finetuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL) to this end. Conventional wisdom dictates that RL enables strong generalization on new tasks without losing existing capabilities, while SFT is prone to weak generalization and catastrophic forgetting. At the same time, SFT can learn from off-policy expert data, whereas RL must rely on a model's ability to find successful trajectories with repeated sampling. In our work, we seek to leverage the strength of on-policy learning while utilizing the privileged information contained in off-policy data. However, rather than modifying the learning objective to accommodate this data, we instead tailor the data distribution to better suit the learner. translated_title: 采样式微调：监督微调（SFT）的学习效果比你想的更好
translated_abstract: 为前沿模型引入新能力一直是后训练的目标，为此通常采用监督微调和强化学习两种方法。传统观点认为，强化学习能够在不损失现有能力的前提下对新任务实现强泛化，而监督微调则容易导致泛化能力差和灾难性遗忘。与此同时，监督微调可以从离策略的专家数据中学习，而强化学习则必须依赖模型通过重复采样来找到成功轨迹的能力。在本工作中，我们试图在利用离策略数据所包含的特权信息的同时，发挥在策略学习的优势。然而，我们并非通过修改学习目标来适配这些数据，而是调整数据分布以使其更适合学习器。我们提出了一种马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）采样算法，能够逐步将离策略轨迹转换为更加……（摘要不完整）
tldr: 该论文提出一种MCMC采样算法，通过逐步将离策略专家数据转换为更接近在策略分布的数据形式，使监督微调（SFT）能够同时享有在策略学习的泛化优势和离策略数据的特权信息，从而证明SFT的学习效果远好于传统认知。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an MCMC sampling algorithm that progressively transforms off-policy expert traces to better suit the learner, enabling SFT to combine the generalization strengths of on-policy learning with privileged information from off-policy data—demonstrating that SFT learns better than conventional wisdom suggests.
